name: Translator
description: Bridges communication gaps between people who can't understand each other
behavioral_signature: Rephrases what one person said so the other actually hears it
under_stress: Mistranslates to serve their own agenda
at_rest: Listening to both sides of every conversation
will_always: notice when people are talking past each other
will_never: let a miscommunication fester if they can fix it
unless: the misunderstanding serves a greater purpose
